jobs.title: Part time Receptionist
jobs.description:
Job Description

Are you an experienced Receptionist looking to join a company with a friendly, family feel? If so, we would love to hear from you!

My client in LS12 is looking for a Receptionist to join them on a part time basis - the days worked are none negotiable of Wednesday, Thursday and Friday. You must also be able to provide full time holiday cover so flexibility is a must.

£12.71 an hour Daily hours are 8-5 with 1 hour for lunch

You must be a pro at multi-tasking - always able to meet and greet with a smile no matter what other tasks you may be doing. This role is really varied and is a long-term career choice - you will become an indispensable part of the team, a real go to person and pivotal in a lot of duties.

The role of Receptionist will be varied but duties will include:

  • Meeting and greeting - signing in and out of visitors and packages.
  • Packing up mail/parcels to send to clients.
  • Organising all post.
  • Operating the switchboard, answering a high volume of calls.
  • Typing up copy and documents.
  • Booking meeting rooms.
  • Managing emails and Teams.
  • Database management.
  • Occasional PA duties (typing/printing of documents) so a high degree of confidentiality is required.
  • Travel booking.
  • Preparing meeting rooms and refreshments.
  • Calling suppliers and facilities when needed.

This is a permanent role with full time holiday cover required.

If you are a friendly and enthusiastic Receptionist looking for a new challenge please click apply today or call Charlotte on

jobs.title: Part Time Administrator - Flexible hours
jobs.description:
Job Description

Our Client is looking for an experienced Administrator to ensure that the day-to-day office administration runs smoothly.

This role would be around 24 hours a week and they can be highly flexible on the days/hours. 

Salary – £27-30,000 FTE based on experience which will be pro-rata'd.

Duties and responsibilities

  • Processing sales orders and invoices.
  • Processing information accurately to match supplier quotes & bill customers correctly.
  • Ensure invoices & statements are checked for accuracy.
  • Scanning, filing and retrieving paperwork both manually and electronically.
  • Organise bi-annual conferences for customers.
  • Ordering stationary and any other office supplies.
  • Create customer templates.
  • Dealing with Petty Cash.
  • Planning the Christmas Party and company events.
  • Any other ad hoc administrative requests.

Attributes Required:

  • Proactive during quieter times.
  • Team player
  • Excellent IT skills
  • Ability to priorities tasks without supervision
  • Trained in the use of Microsoft Packages including Word, Excel and Outlook
  • Enthusiastic, friendly and approachable

What’s in it for you?

  • 5% pension employer contribution
  • 20 days holiday increasing each year plus bank holidays and Christmas annual break (on top of your allowance)
  • Free parking near the city
  • Competitive salary in the market
  • Flexibility on hours

jobs.description:
Job Description

Part-Time Temporary Admin Support

We are currently recruiting for a Part-Time Temporary Admin Support role to join a This is a great opportunity for someone who is highly organised, detail-oriented, and enjoys supporting operational processes.

Location: Ossett

Salary: £26 – 28k

Contract: Temporary, Part-Time

Working Pattern: Flexible working days between Tuesday and Friday

Key Responsibilities :

  • Providing administrative support to the Quality Management Team
  • Processing and updating information accurately within internal systems
  • Maintaining organised filing systems (both electronic and paper-based)

What They Offer:

  • Flexible part-time working (Tuesday to Friday)
  • Competitive salary (pro rata)
  • Immediate start
  • 6 months long term temp

If you are looking for a flexible, part-time temporary role and have strong admin skills, we would love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Office Administrator (Part-Time - School Hours)
jobs.description:
Job Description

Are you an organised, proactive individual looking for a flexible part-time role? We’re looking for an Office Administrator to join our friendly team. This position is ideal for someone who enjoys variety in their day and wants a role that fits around school hours. Full training will be provided.

 What You’ll Be Doing

  • Processing, despatching, and invoicing customer orders
  • Providing excellent customer service via phone and email
  • Liaising with the production team on customer requirements and raw materials
  • Managing purchasing tasks, including processing and tracking orders
  • Handling customer, supplier, and carrier queries (phone/email)
  • Booking transport and despatches using carrier systems
  • Assisting with stock takes and general inventory management

What We’re Looking For

  • Confident using Microsoft Office and spreadsheets
  • Experience with Sage 50 and Sage 200 (CIM50/CIM200 manufacturing experience preferred).
  • Excellent communication and organisational skills
  • Accuracy, attention to detail, and a can-do attitude
  • Willingness to learn – training will be provided

Why Join Us?

  • Part-time hours that fit around school times
  • Supportive and welcoming team
  • Varied, hands-on role in a busy office environment

 Benefits include:

  • 20 days annual leave plus Bank Holidays
  • Birthday day off
  • Pension options
  • Healthcare Cash Back Plan
  • Staff parties/socials
  • Free tea/coffee
  • Staff training/development
  • Opportunities for career progression
  • Free parking
  • Annual bonus potential

How to apply:

If you’re interested in this role and would like to learn more we’d love to hear from you! Please attach your CV to the link provided and we will be in contact.
